title: V3 D6 restore_candidate AB
primary_variable: D5 restore_candidate delta top-up after partial exit fill
fixed_assumptions: stock leg only; ETF leg is fixed validation shell
same unified runtime combo NAV; precomputed component results not allowed
ranking, entry rules, pool, execution clock, costs, account allocator fixed
restore candidate only arms after real partial D5 sell fill and is capped to original target delta

evidence.note: D6 restore_candidate AB detailed audit report

key_findings: Restore candidate underperforms D5 immediate in all three stock-leg same-window comparisons.
Restore buy count is small: 1217=1, 1626=4, 1226=3; sample size is too small for threshold tuning but sufficient to reject this runtime rule as a baseline candidate.
D5 immediate still improves stock-leg same-run B0 replay; this AB rejects restore_candidate, not D5 immediate itself.
No baseline promotion: keep result as negative evidence and audit artifact.

decision.reason: Restore candidate loses to D5 immediate on stock leg across 1217, 1626, and 1226, with no reliable drawdown improvement.

next_actions: Do not promote D6 restore_candidate to V4 or live baseline.
If continuing D5 research, separate D5 immediate baseline audit from any restore/top-up behavior.
Study fully-exit natural re-entry or stricter residual-holding conditions instead of restoring half-held names.
